# Comandos que rodam na Container VM (docker, podman, nerdctl); os do
# Mac, quando existem, vêm antes.
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.gantry/bin"
" with administrator privileges with prompt "O Gantry quer apontar /var/run/docker.sock para a Container VM."
[ -n "$gw" ] || { echo 'sem rota padrão'; exit 1; }
do shell script "
docker context use

docker ps --no-trunc --format '{{.ID}} {{.Names}} {{.Label "com.docker.compose.project"}}' 2>/dev/null
sudo podman ps --no-trunc --format '{{.ID}} {{.Names}} {{index .Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' 2>/dev/null
dpkg -s nfs-kernel-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nfs-kernel-server; }
echo "ip=$(ip -4 -o addr show scope global | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 | head -n1)"

echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1' >/etc/sysctl.d/90-gantry.conf
sysctl -q -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 1 >/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward || true
if command -v rc-update >/dev/null 2>&1; then rc-update add sysctl boot >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
for ipt in iptables ip6tables; do
  if command -v "$ipt" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$ipt" -S FORWARD 2>/dev/null | grep -qx -- '-P FORWARD DROP'; then
    "$ipt" -P FORWARD ACCEPT || true
  fi
done
if [ -f /etc/inittab ] && grep -Eq '^(ttyS|ttyAMA)[0-9]+::' /etc/inittab; then
  sed -i -E 's/^((ttyS|ttyAMA)[0-9]+::)/#\1/' /etc/inittab
  kill -HUP 1 || true
fi
if [ -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config ] && ! grep -q '^# gantry: ssh do Gantry' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.gantry-antes
  printf '\n# gantry: ssh do Gantry (vsock, 127.0.0.1) fora do log\nMatch Address 127.0.0.1,::1\n    LogLevel ERROR\n' >>/etc/ssh/sshd_config
  if sshd -t >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/sbin/sshd -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
%[1]s
  else
    mv /etc/ssh/sshd_config.gantry-antes /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  fi
fi
if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ] && [ ! -e /etc/sudoers.d/gantry-logs ]; then
  printf 'Cmnd_Alias GANTRY_LOGS = /usr/bin/tail, /usr/bin/journalctl, /bin/journalctl\nDefaults!GANTRY_LOGS !syslog\n' >/etc/sudoers.d/gantry-logs
  chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/gantry-logs
  visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/gantry-logs >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/gantry-logs
fi

if [ ! -e /etc/systemd/system/gantry-vsock-mem.service ]; then
printf '[Unit]
Description=Gantry: memoria para o Mac
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat VSOCK-LISTEN:%d,reuseaddr,fork OPEN:/proc/meminfo,rdonly
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/gantry-vsock-mem.service >/dev/null
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now gantry-vsock-mem.service || true
fi
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null; then sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %[1]d -u docker.service -u containerd.service; else sudo tail -n %[1]d /var/log/docker.log; fi
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null; then sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %[1]d -u podman.service -u podman.socket; else sudo tail -n %[1]d /var/log/podman.log; fi
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null; then sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %[1]d; else sudo tail -n %[1]d /var/log/messages; fi
ip -4 -o addr show scope global | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 | head -n1

sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-user-static || sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-user qemu-user-binfmt
sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %d
sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %d -u docker.service -u containerd.service
sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o short-iso -n %d -u podman.service -u podman.socket
sudo journalctl -f -n 300 --no-pager
t=$(printf '\t'); while IFS= read -r l; do p=${l%"$t"*}; m=${l##*"$t"}; touch -c -m -d "@$m" -- "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
